Inclusion Criteria:
  -  The chILD syndrome exists when a child with DLD has had the common causes of DLD excluded  [AND] as the primary diagnosis and has at least three of the following four criteria: (1) respiratory symptoms (e

right.raw_text: , cough, rapid  [OR] and/or difficult breathing, [OR]  or exercise intolerance);(2) respiratory signs (e

left.raw_text: , resting tachypnea, [OR]  adventitious sounds, [OR]  retractions, [OR]  digital clubbing, [OR]  failure to thrive, [OR]  or respiratory fail- ure); (3) hypoxemia; and (4) diffuse abnormalities on CXR  [OR] or a CT scan

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  These include cystic fibrosis, congenital  [OR] or acquired immunodeficiency, [OR]  congenital heart disease, [OR]  bronchopulmonary dysplasia, [OR]  pulmonary infection, primary ciliary dyskinesia presenting with newborn respiratory distress  [OR] and recurrent aspiration
